name: Bridge Impact AI
description: AI驱动的原住民和解实践平台，为组织和个人提供可衡量的和解行动工具，资助青年主导的社区项目，并提供原住民文化历史学习资源；其AI咨询功能基于原住民知识数据集训练
description_en: AI-driven platform offering tools for organizations and individuals to measure and implement Indigenous reconciliation practices, fund youth-led community projects, and learn about Indigenous culture and history; AI trained on Indigenous knowledge datasets
why_matters: 由原住民顾问委员会主导开发，AI基于原住民世界观和知识数据集训练（而非殖民数据集），为组织提供第三方验证的和解行动计划，填补加拿大80%民众希望参与和解但缺乏明确下一步行动的空白
why_matters_en: Led by Indigenous advisory board, AI trained on datasets from Indigenous worldview and knowledge rather than colonial datasets with built-in bias; provides third-party verification of organizational reconciliation actions, addressing gap where 80% of Canadians want to participate in reconciliation but lack clear next steps
latest_news: 2026年9月在维多利亚科技周软启动beta版应用，目前正在申请非营利组织身份，并寻求组织合作伙伴共同开发技术；计划2027年春季扩展至澳大利亚
latest_news_en: Soft-launched beta app at Victoria Tech Week in September 2026; currently applying for non-profit status and seeking organizational partners to co-develop tech; planning expansion to Australia in spring 2027
source_title: With launch of new app, BC startup Bridge looks to digitize reconciliation

evidence.quote: The intention behind this is to build a data set that is built from the Indigenous worldview, based on Indigenous knowledge … because the majority of AI, like Claude or Gemini, they pull from colonial data sets that have bias built in

name: H2 Analytics
description: 军事训练演习开发平台Exercise Architect Suite(EASE),通过AI增强应急模拟和规划能力的真实性
description_en: Military training exercise development platform (EASE) with AI-enhanced emergency simulation and planning capabilities for improved realism
why_matters: 加拿大国防科技公司,三年收入增长率552%,近六个月新增22名员工,预计收入再次翻倍,已进入欧洲、中东、澳大利亚和新西兰市场
why_matters_en: Canadian defence tech with 552% three-year revenue growth, added 22 employees in six months, projecting revenue doubling, expanding to Europe, Middle East, Australia and New Zealand
latest_news: 2026年10月获得加拿大联邦经济发展署FedDev Ontario提供的80万加元可偿还资金,用于升级EASE平台的AI功能
latest_news_en: Secured $800,000 CAD in repayable funding from FedDev Ontario in October 2026 to upgrade EASE platform with AI features
source_title: H2 Analytics secures $800,000 in FedDev funding to improve defence training platform

evidence.quote: recently placed 52nd on The Globe and Mail 's Top Growing Companies list , with a three-year revenue growth rate of 552 percent

name: スマートエイト
description: 法人向けAI活用支援を提供する企業。ChatGPTやClaudeなどのツール導入だけでなく、業務課題の整理から研修、コンサルティング、開発まで一気通貫で支援。経営者向けマンツーマン伴走支援やClaude Code環境構築、Web広告代理店向けSaaS「Smart Ad Report」も提供。
description_en: Corporate AI adoption consulting firm providing end-to-end support from identifying business challenges to training, consulting, and development. Services include one-on-one executive coaching, Claude Code environment setup, and Smart Ad Report SaaS for web advertising agencies.
why_matters: 既存SaaSでは対応できない業務特有のニッチな課題をAIで仕組み化できる点が差別化要因。生成AIによって自社専用の小規模アプリや業務ツールを短期間で開発可能にし、定型業務削減を実現。代表は大手教育・人材企業で事業開発を経験し、自社でもAIを使い倒して成果を出す実践力を持つ。
why_matters_en: Differentiates by automating niche business-specific tasks that existing SaaS cannot handle. Uses generative AI to build custom small-scale apps and tools quickly, reducing routine work. CEO has business development experience at major education and HR firms and demonstrates strong practical AI implementation capabilities within the company.
latest_news: 2025年3月に株式会社スマートエイトを設立。現在、広告代理店・商社・製造業・医療法人など幅広い業界に向けてAI活用・業務自動化支援を展開中。
latest_news_en: Founded SmartEight Inc. in March 2025. Currently providing AI adoption and business automation support to diverse industries including advertising agencies, trading companies, manufacturing, and medical corporations.
source_title: 【#765】AIで定型業務を減らし、人間が「価値創造」に集中できる社会へ - ベンチャー.jp

evidence.quote: 早稲田大学卒業後、ベネッセコーポレーションで教育事業の企画に6年間従事。リクルートでは事業開発組織のゼネラルマネージャーを担当。2025年3月に株式会社スマートエイトを設立

name: Alma
description: 专注于让计算机使用更快速和更经济的个人计算平台，由曾在Microsoft Research工作并担任Sarvam AI创始工程师的团队打造
description_en: A personal computing platform focused on making computer use faster and more affordable, built by founders who previously worked at Microsoft Research and were founding engineers at Sarvam AI
why_matters: 由微软研究院和印度语言AI模型公司Sarvam AI的资深工程师创立，获得Peak XV的Surge 12投资，致力于重新定义个人计算体验的底层平台
why_matters_en: Founded by veterans from Microsoft Research and Sarvam AI, backed by Peak XV's Surge 12 program, aiming to redefine the underlying platform for personal computing experience
latest_news: 2026年9月入选Peak XV的Surge 12加速计划，该计划将单个公司投资上限提高至500万美元
latest_news_en: Selected for Peak XV's Surge 12 cohort in September 2026, which raised the investment ceiling to $5 million per company
source_title: Peak XV ups Surge seed investment ceiling to $5M, unveils 18-startup cohort | TechCrunch

evidence.quote: Peak XV Partners, one of the largest venture capital firms investing in markets, including India and Southeast Asia with more than $10 billion in assets under management, has increased how much it invests per startup through Surge, its seed-stage investing platform, as it unveils a new cohort of 18 companies.
Its founders previously worked at Microsoft Research and were founding engineers at Sarvam AI, a Bengaluru-based startup building AI models for Indian languages.
